# Kanapet — Small Pet & Bird Cage Manufacturer (OEM/ODM)

> Kanapet (Foshan Kanyue) is a Chinese manufacturer of bird cages, hamster cages,
> travel carriers and small pet accessories, founded in 1991. 20,000㎡ factory in
> Shishan Town, Nanhai District, Foshan, Guangdong. Wholesale and OEM/ODM only —
> custom colors, logo printing, private label and packaging. Contact: lena@kanapet.com,
> WhatsApp +86 15221878306.

## Key facts
- Founded: 1991
- Factory: 20,000㎡, Foshan, Guangdong, China
- Business model: B2B wholesale / OEM / ODM (no retail)
- Product range: 70 SKUs across bird cages, hamster cages, travel carriers and accessories
- Certifications & capability: in-house manufacturing, custom tooling, private label

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.kanapet.com/): company overview and capability summary
- [All Products](https://www.kanapet.com/products.html): full catalog with filters
- [Our Factory](https://www.kanapet.com/factory.html): production facility and capacity
- [OEM & ODM](https://www.kanapet.com/oem-odm.html): custom manufacturing process
- [Contact](https://www.kanapet.com/contact.html): inquiry form and WhatsApp
